tools.name: social_search
tools.description: Search a single network for posts matching a query, returned as the unified Post[] schema and tagged with its platform. Keyless on TikTok, YouTube, and Pinterest. Instagram, Twitter/X, Reddit, and Facebook need operator-side credentials (returns credentials_required until set). Snapchat and Threads

tools.name: social_comments
tools.description: Comments / replies on one post as the unified Comment[] schema, tagged with its platform. Provide url OR postId. tools.name: search_all
tools.description: The wedge no incumbent offers: fan one search query out across the requested platforms (default: all keyless, non-disabled) in parallel, merge the unified Post[], and tag each result with its platform. tools.name: reddit_history
tools.description: Keyless full-history pull via Arctic Shift — a user's or subreddit's posts, or a keyword search across Reddit history, returned as the unified Post[]. Provide at least one of username, subreddit, or q. Optional before/after bound the window by epoch-seconds or ISO timestamp.

tools.name: facebook_ads
tools.description: Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ad Library records as the unified Ad[] (id, pageName, adCreativeBody, adSnapshotUrl, startDate, currency, spend + impression ranges). Provide q OR pageId. GATED — needs operator-side FACEBOOK_ACCESS_TOKEN (with ads_read); returns credentials_required until set.

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: Available caption-language list (and cue segments where retrievable) for a YouTube video. Provide url OR videoId. Keyless. NOTE: actual cue text is BotGuard-gated keyless, so it is reported honestly (available:false, empty segments) rather than fabricated.

tools.name: threads_post
tools.description: Fetch a single thread by shortcode or URL, including its replies, as the unified Post (with replies). Provide code OR url. Keyless.

tools.name: snapchat_spotlight
tools.description: A creator's public Snapchat Spotlight feed as the unified Post[] with real view/comment/share counts. Keyless.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "threads_post" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: social_profile, social_posts, social_search, search_all, reddit_history, youtube_transcript, threads_post, snapchat_spotlight · Private data: social_profile, social_posts, social_search, social_comments, facebook_ads · Public sink: social_posts, social_search, social_comments, search_all, reddit_history, threads_post, snapchat_spotlight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: social_profile, social_posts, social_search, search_all, reddit_history, youtube_transcript, threads_post, snapchat_spotlight · Private data: social_profile, social_posts, social_search, social_comments, facebook_ads · Public sink: social_posts, social_search, social_comments, search_all, reddit_history, threads_post, snapchat_spotlight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
